accept.identity_source: actual validated accepted observer tuple, full epoch retained

publish.identity_source: pending accepted epoch copied to active on exact matching CTLM token/context-bank load

fetch.identity_source: active epoch[fetch_user] plus exact row token selected for that fetch

core_start.identity_source: CTLM emb_token and explicit emb_user; SYSFACE active[emb_user] must equal held row epoch

native_command.identity_source: released token18 carried in actual EMB command, must equal row token

release.identity_source: immutable scheduled edge strictly after final native code AND scale read

retire.identity_source: immutable scheduled identity invalidation only outside residency

expected_words.identity_source: held fetch snapshot, never latest pending or live host epoch

constraints: every expected word uses held fetch token/epoch
final SRAM code AND scale write strictly before core_start sample
core_start <= native_command with actual native source age priced
no publish or retire of resident user between fetch and release
at most one unpublished accepted epoch per user; second acceptance before publish faults

identity_modes.cold_user0: validated new-context epoch published at exact user0 bank initialization; current production edge unbound
identity_modes.ordinary_user0: may update next token while old resident row executes; pending epoch never replaces active bank early; requires exact d_start association
identity_modes.filler_steady: token updates r_fill, epoch belongs to published context until matching scheduled context reload
identity_modes.filler_reload: accepted epoch pending until masked ctx_ld bank publication; cannot publish that user during residency

production_missing: user0 validated tuple source and INIT/d_start epoch transition
exact accepted observer→CTLM ctx_ld bank edge including SF/die/LP ages and masks
explicit emb_user2 pin and physical cost
single row serialization across ordinary/cold/filler schedules
cap1 emitter and actual INIT after row completion
